verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's core product is email campaign creation with drag-and-drop editor, audience segmentation, and API-level campaign creation endpoint, plus AI-assisted composer that builds audience/content/send strategy. Evidence covers UI editor (docs-11, docs-19, docs-27), segmentation (docs-11), API campaign creation (docs-7), and AI composer for campaign drafting (docs-25, docs-10). missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshot of the scheduling step in the UI flow and independent/hands-on confirmation of the end-to-end send flow.
